items.risk: Network Software operating margin fell to 41.0% from 43.9%, partly reflecting acquired-business profiles.
Interest expense increased because of higher average debt and rates, a counterweight to portfolio cash generation.

Acquisition-led growth can mask weaker organic economics or create integration/margin dilution.
Higher debt costs can reduce flexibility if acquisition cadence remains high.
